s: Dine hakkeriot besiyyum y"ch berakot ubo ch' seipim: hammitpallel tzarik sheyyipsa g' pesiot laachorayv kederek shenniptarim millipne hammelek veachar kak yitten shalom, veim lo asa ken — keillu lo hitpallel. Venoten shalom techilla lismolo shehi yemin hashshekina hashsheruya negdo betzeto min hattepilla, veachar kak limino shehu semol hashshekina, dehaynu shekkesheomer "oseh shalom bimromayv" — yitteh berosho letzad semolo, ukesheomer "hu yaaseh shalom alenu" — yitteh berosho letzad yemino, velo yitten shalom beshaa shepposea ella leachar kak. Veqodem shepposea yesh lo likroa, veyipsa hag' pesiot bikria achat, ubeodo korea qodem sheyyizqop — yitten shalom lismolo velimino. Vehurgelu lehishtachavot achar kak lipne Hashem, keebed hanniptar merabbo. Venahagu lomar achar kak "yehi ratzon … sheyyibbaneh bet hammiqdash ku'", ki hattepilla bimqom haaboda velaken anu mebaqshim al hammiqdash shennukal laasot aboda mammash:
Mi shemmosip al g' pesiot — yuhara hi, shennireh choleq kabod lashshekina yoter mishshear bene adam:

Bemaqom shekkalu hag' pesiot — yaamod, velo yachazor limqomo ad sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur liqdushsha, sheim chozer miyyad — domeh letalmid shenniptar merabbo upasa laachorayv vechozer miyyad, shessopo mokiach al techillato shello pasa laachorayv kede lippater mimmennu, abal keshemmaggia sheliach tzibbur liqdushsha — nireh lakkol shechozer bishbil haqqedushsha. Veyesh omerim shemmishshehitchil sheliach tzibbur lehitpallel beqol ram — muttar lachazor limqomo, mippene shennireh lakkol shechozer bishbil lekavven lemah sheyyomar hashsheliach tzibbur. Vehashsheliach tzibbur atzmo yakol lachazor miyyad min haddin, shennireh lakkol sheoseh ken kede lehotzi rabbim yede chobatan, ella shennahagu laamod kede hilluk d' ammot. Veken yachid hammitpallel day lo sheyyaamod kede hilluk d' ammot lepi sebara zo. Abal lepi sebara harishona yesh omerim sheggam yachid hammitpallel tzarik lehamtin keshiur sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur liqdushsha, im lo shetztzarik lachazor ulehitpallel shenit, kegon letashlumin, sheaz ledibre hakkol day sheyyamtin kede hilluk d' ammot mittaam shennitbaer besiman q"h, velo yoter, mippene shennireh lakkol shechozer limqomo kede lachazor ulehitpallel. Veken im chozer limqomo kede lippol al panayv meyushshab, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ql"a. Uleinyan maaseh, bemaqom sheepshar beqal — yesh lachosh lassebara harishona. Veken nohagin. Abal bemaqom sheyyesh dochaq bebet hakkeneset veyabou lide machaloqet — yakol lachazor limqomo miyyad sheppatach hashsheliach tzibbur beqol ram. Ukesheomerim piyyutim qodem qedushsha — ledibre hakkol en tzarik laamod ad qedushsha, ella miyyad sheppatach sheliach tzibbur beqol ram — chozer limqomo:

Im hu rotzeh omed bammaqom sheppasa veeno chozer limqomo. Veyesh omerim sheyyesh lipsoa v' pesiot, g' laachorayv veg' beshubo limqomo, sheyyesh lo lachazor limqomo beg' pesiot lepanayv. Umittaam zeh qetzat maqpidin shello yaabor adam lipnehem beod shehem omedin bemaqom sheppasa shello yapsiq zeh ben v' pesiotehem, abal mikkol maqom al yede qepidatam toim, shekkesheroim mi sherotzeh laabor lipnehem — hem memaharim lachazor limqoman qodem shiur shennitbaer:

Yachid shemmitpallel betzibbur vesiyyem tepillato qodem latztzibbur — en lo reshut lehachazir panayv latztzibbur ad sheyyesayyem sheliach tzibbur tepillato, sheaz rashshay lehachazir panayv, abal lo lachazor limqomo ad sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur liqdushsha bemaqom sheepshar kemo shennitbaer. Veyesh machamirim laamod bammaqom sheppasa ulekavven sham raglayv kemo battepilla ad sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur liqdushsha. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem. Ukeshepposea — oqer regel semol techilla, lepi shedderek halikat adam bistam hi laaqor regel yamin techilla, laken oqer kan regel semol techilla leharot keillu kabed alayv lippater millipne hammaqom. Umittaam zeh itter regel oqer techilla semolo shehu yemin kol adam:

Shiur pesiot ellu, lekol happachot hu kede sheyyitten gudal betzad aqeb, vaapillu im hammaqom tzar, lepi sheppachot mizzeh enah niqret pesia kelal. Ulekattechilla lo yapsia pesiot gassot yoter mizzeh, mippene shennireh keratz millipne hammelek:

Gam hashsheliach tzibbur tzarik lipsoa g' pesiot keshemmitpallel belachash. Abal keshechozer hattepilla beqol ram — en tzarik lachazor velipsoa g' pesiot, mippene shessomek al happesiot shebbesop haqqaddish shalem shettiqqenuhu chakamim lishliach tzibbur achar kol tepilla, ella shemmapsiqim biqriat seper tora veseder qedushsha vehallel ve"abinu malkenu" vekol kayyotze bahen shekkullan leseder hattepilla baim, veqaddish shelleacharehem chozer iqqar al tepillat y"ch. Veim ba lipsoa gam achar tepillat y"ch — en limchot beyado. Veim lo hitpallel belachash raq beqol ram — tzarik lipsoa g' pesiot achar tepillato shebbeqol ram millebad happesiot sheachar haqqaddish:

Keshehashsheliach tzibbur chozer hattepilla — en tzarik lomar "yihyu leratzon" besop hattepilla, mippene shessomek al "titqabbel tzelotehon" shebbesop haqqaddish. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik lomar "yihyu leratzon" besop hattepilla. Venohagin kassebara harishona. Veap al pi ken tob lachosh lisbara acharona:
